description: A lasting state — offline, a sync error, a trial ending (DESIGN.md, Banner): a status icon, a title, a message and actions at the end, under the text when narrow. The fill is tone's colour at 13 % with a 1 px ring at 32 %, never a coloured side stripe. onClose adds a close button. It does not announce itself: it is part of the page, not an interruption (use a Toast for that).

constructors.description: A banner of tone titled title.

params.name: title
params.description: What the state is, in TsuyaType.bodyStrong.

params.name: message
params.description: A sentence of detail under the title, in TsuyaColors.textMuted.

params.name: actions
params.description: Buttons at the end of the banner, usually small ones.

params.name: onClose
params.description: Shows a close button, called when it is pressed.
